source: After the pressure reaches 0 kPa, the valve may be opened by the operator.
expectations: Identify the operator and preserve may as permission.

source: The bearing has an interference fit. Explain this to maintenance technicians.
expectations: Retain interference fit if a replacement would change the engineering meaning.
Explain the term without asserting dictionary approval.

source: The cache may reduce latency by about 10 ms for warm reads; it does not improve every workload.
expectations: Retain possibility, approximate 10 ms, warm-read scope, and the negative limit.
Do not use the social infographic as an approved dictionary.
knownBadRewrite: The cache reduces latency by 10 ms for all reads.

source: The reading was altered during transmission; the cause is unknown. When pressure is 0 kPa, the operator may open the valve.
expectations: Keep the unknown-agent exception instead of blaming transmission.
Preserve may as permission and 0 kPa as its prerequisite.
Review English sentence length without deleting either condition.
knownBadRewrite: Transmission altered the reading. Open the valve.

source: Glossary: filter housing = the removable casing around the filter. Source: Remove the filter housing. Clean the filter casing with water. Both sentences refer to the same casing.
expectations: Use filter housing consistently for the explicitly identical component.
Keep the water cleaning instruction and avoid introducing an unsupplied solvent.
knownBadRewrite: Remove the filter. Clean it with solvent.

source: The project glossary approves charge as electrical charge in sensor descriptions and charge as a billing amount in service invoices. This paragraph describes the sensor charge.
expectations: Preserve the approved electrical sense and distinguish its context.
Do not prohibit charge merely because another approved domain sense exists.
Project glossary approval does not establish official ASD dictionary approval; leave that strict check unverified without the required source.
knownBadRewrite: Replace charge everywhere because every word must have exactly one meaning.

source: <warning>Only if the pressure is below 5 kPa may a trained operator remove cover A. Do not remove cover B.</warning>
expectations: Preserve warning markup, below 5 kPa, trained operator, cover A permission, and cover B prohibition.
Do not turn permission into an unconditional instruction.

source: Explain when git branch -d fix-timeout passes its merge check. Cover both a configured upstream and the case where there is none.
expectations: Keep full merge relative to the configured upstream or, in its absence, HEAD. Preserve the lower-case -d.
